topic: Calibrating facility data for specific categories
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on updating calibration settings for a specific company (7856) within the City and Bus Shelter categories. Initially, [p1] requested changing the calibration for these categories to stage 89. The data provided showed multiple facilities with varying signal limits (e.g., 81 vs 89). After discussion, it was decided that instead of leaving all existing facility calibrations, they should be updated/deleted and reapplied based on the category requirements.

Separately, [me] shared SQL queries comparing session data for a package (`_pkg_7600_202309`) from two different sources (a new local dataset vs. an old concept dataset). The comparison highlighted discrepancies in absolute values of sessions between August 1 and September 27.
decisions: Calibration settings for City and Bus Shelter facilities for company 7856 were updated to stage 89, requiring the deletion/reapplication of existing facility-specific calibrations.
action_items: [p1] will review the provided session data comparison queries on Monday.
